card.text: Explore Skathi, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Skathi travels around Saturn on a tilted retrograde orbit. Cassini brightness variations constrain a minimum equatorial ratio of 1.27:1, while its polar depth and spin orientation remain unknown. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.27:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
